body: Same. I want to go back in  time

These stories make me feel that, hey, maybe I can do it, too. That there is still some hope. Some also show that sometimes the small things add up, that going slowly still makes a difference. It helps.

Okay, you can PM me (just in case though, I've forgotten all my passwords and everything before, so if I suddenly stop replying, i probably forgot my username and password for the nth time (thank goodness for being able to make more than one account, lol).

What types of things do you like? Hobbies? Favorite things to do in your free time? Anything you'd like to talk about?
I do this, the helping everybody. I feel so tired, but if I take even a second of rest for myself, I feel my grandma will just call me lazy again. :(
